description.value:
Cloaking Technique. You bend chakra around yourself to refract light and dampen sound, becoming difficult to perceive. You gain the invisible condition until you make a Strike, cast a damaging jutsu, or Sustain a different concentration effect.

If you take any Stride action, you also benefit from a +2 status bonus to Stealth checks made during the same turn. After breaking invisibility, you cannot recast this jutsu until the start of your next turn.

Cloaking does not fool true-sight, chakra-sense, or other precise non-visual senses.

Heightened (5th) The first Strike or damaging jutsu you make does not end the invisibility.
